Lyles and Ajayi ran through semi final one easily enough, bringing Akani Simbine sub 10 for a time qualifier.
The highlight of the semis was the second heat where Thompson and Kenny Bednarek battled to an exact time tie at 9.844.
In an extreme statistical rarity, 3rd and 4th place Zharnel Hughes and Jerome Blake also had an exact time tie in a non-qualifying 10.022.
In the third semi, Seville showed his brilliance with a 9.86 separating from returning silver medalist and Olympic 200 gold medalist Letsile Tebogo.
